paper_title: Unifying inflation with the axion, dark matter, baryogenesis and the seesaw mechanism
notes: This is a theoretical model-building paper (SMASH) unifying inflation, axion dark matter, baryogenesis and seesaw. It predicts an axion DM mass window 50-200 ueV (fA ~ 3e10-1.2e11 GeV) but presents no measured/observed exclusion limit or sensitivity projection on any coupling. Not an experimental limit paper; no extractable (mass, coupling) data points. | Coupling from pre-classifier (AxionMass, conf=0.70)
